evidence.source: Academia Sinica, International Computer Chinese Characters and Variant Forms Knowledge Base
evidence.text: The entry labels 京 forms as oracle-bone, bronze, and small-seal script. Its explanation reads the oracle-bone and bronze forms as a tall building, with roof, tower, and wall; it says the small-seal form simplifies the tower element to 口. This is a database interpretation of the graph, not a dated sequence of individual attestations.

evidence.text: The file page says the modern SVG was made from a scan of Kyoto University’s Institute for Research in Humanities Oracle Bone Script Character No. 1402, catalog p. 66. Its caption associates the catalog form with 𢀛, so this does not establish that it represents 京. It is a modern redraw based on a catalog image, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; exclude it from the selected 京 glyphs because its character identity is mismatched.

search_audit.query: 京 甲骨文 金文 字形 演变 小学堂 Academia Sinica 京 字形
search_audit.outcome: Inspected Academia Sinica’s character-specific evolution page and oracle-bone database landing page. The evolution page supports the reported building interpretation; no dated individual 京 attestations were available there.

search_audit.query: Wikimedia Commons 京 oracle bone script bronze script glyph image
search_audit.outcome: Inspected file descriptions and licenses. The 京 Shang oracle vector is identified and marked public domain; the Kyoto University-based drawing is identified as 𢀛 and excluded. The web tool reported fetch failures for the two direct SVG requests, but their URLs were linked from the inspected file pages.

search_audit.query: 京 ancient Chinese character oracle bone bronze Wikimedia Commons file
search_audit.outcome: Search returned the same two character-specific Commons file descriptions; inspected both and rejected the Kyoto University candidate on identity grounds.

search_audit.query: site:xiaoxue.iis.sinica.edu.tw 京 甲骨文 字形 京 字形演变
search_audit.outcome: Search surfaced Xiaoxuetang character pages, but inspected samples belonged to unrelated graphs, not 京. The official guide states that glyph images obtained through the query interface are CC0 1.0, but no character-specific 京 result was verified, so none was selected.

gaps: Only one candidate image was verified as a depiction of 京 with reusable rights. Commons also lists other script-stage variants, but no individual direct image file for a later stage was opened and verified in this run.

The direct SVG fetches produced tool-level errors; URLs are recorded as direct links from the inspected Commons descriptions, not as successfully fetched image contents. No claim of pixel inspection is made.
The Commons oracle-style vector cites hanziyuan.net record B08320 as its source; its file page does not describe it as an artifact photograph. It is a modern vector redraw.

items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 京 in Shang oracle-bone script style, based on the B08320 form cited by the file page.
items.alt: Modern vector drawing of an oracle-bone-style form identified as 京.
items.selection_reason: It is a character-specific, licensed early-form candidate and can illustrate the broad building interpretation while being clearly labeled as a redraw.
items.rights: Public domain, according to the Commons file page; attribution appreciated but not required.

limitations.text: The single selected example is a modern vector redraw of a script style, not a photograph or facsimile of a dated Shang inscription. A second Commons candidate based on a Kyoto University catalog scan was excluded because its file page identifies the form as 𢀛 rather than 京.
